newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Frans Maas buys stake in Finnish transport group.
newsitem.headline: Frans Maas buys stake in Finnish transport group.

text.p: Koninklijke Frans Maas Group said on Thursday it had acquired a 73 pct stake in Finnish transport group Finn-Pex Trans Oy.

"Frans Maas has taken a majority interest of 73 percent in Finn-Pex Trans Oy in Finland, a company specialised in the area of international haulage activities," the road transport group said in a statement.
Frans Maas said the acquisition would strengthen its European network. Frans Maas and Finn-Pex have cooperated successfully for a number of years, it added.
Unlisted Finn-Pex is one of Finland's leading road hauliers, albeit relatively small, a spokesman said. He declined to say how much the company had paid for the stake, acquired from Finn-Pex itself.
